an3.71:1.1: 72 ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an3.71:1.2: athakho channo paribbājako yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā ānandena saddhiṃ sammodi
an3.71:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho channo paribbājako āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca
an3.71:1.4: tumhepi āvuso ānanda rāgassa pahānaṃ paññāpetha dosassa pahānaṃ paññāpetha mohassa pahānaṃ paññāpethāti.
an3.71:1.5: mayaṃ kho āvuso rāgassa pahānaṃ paññāpema dosassa pahānaṃ paññāpema mohassa pahānaṃ paññāpemāti.
an3.71:2.1: kiṃ pana tumhe āvuso rāge ādīnavaṃ disvā rāgassa pahānaṃ paññāpetha kiṃ dose ādīnavaṃ disvā dosassa pahānaṃ paññāpetha kiṃ mohe ādīnavaṃ disvā mohassa pahānaṃ paññāpethāti.
an3.71:3.1: ratto kho āvuso rāgena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto attabyābādhāyapi ceteti parabyābādhāyapi ceteti ubhayabyābādhāyapi ceteti cetasikaṃpi dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti
an3.71:3.2: rāge pahīne neva attabyābādhāya ceteti na parabyābādhāya ceteti na ubhayabyābādhāya ceteti na cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti
an3.71:3.3: ratto kho āvuso rāgena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto kāyena duccaritaṃ carati vācāya duccaritaṃ carati manasā duccaritaṃ carati
an3.71:3.4: rāge pahīne neva kāyena duccaritaṃ carati na vācāya duccaritaṃ carati na manasā duccaritaṃ carati
an3.71:3.5: ratto kho āvuso rāgena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto attatthaṃpi yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti paratthaṃpi yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti ubhayatthaṃpi yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti
an3.71:3.6: rāge pahīne attatthaṃpi yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti paratthaṃpi yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ubhayatthaṃpi yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
an3.71:3.7: rāgo kho āvuso andhakaraṇo acakkhukaraṇo aññāṇakaraṇo paññānirodhiko vighātapakkhiko anibbānasaṃvattaniko
an3.71:4.2: mūḷho kho āvuso mohena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto attabyābādhāyapi ceteti parabyābādhāyapi ceteti ubhayabyābādhāyapi ceteti cetasikaṃpi dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti
an3.71:4.3: mohe pahīne neva attabyābādhāya ceteti na parabyābādhāya ceteti na ubhayabyābādhāya ceteti na cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti
an3.71:4.4: mūḷho kho āvuso mohena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto kāyena duccaritaṃ carati vācāya duccaritaṃ carati manasā duccaritaṃ carati
an3.71:4.5: mohe pahīne neva kāyena duccaritaṃ carati na vācāya duccaritaṃ carati na manasā duccaritaṃ carati
an3.71:4.6: mūḷho kho āvuso mohena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto attatthaṃpi yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti paratthaṃpi yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti ubhayatthaṃpi yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti
an3.71:4.7: mohe pahīne attatthaṃpi yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti paratthaṃpi yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ubhayatthaṃpi yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
an3.71:4.8: moho kho āvuso andhakaraṇo acakkhukaraṇo aññāṇakaraṇo paññānirodhiko vighātapakkhiko anibbānasaṃvattaniko
an3.71:4.9: idaṃ kho mayaṃ āvuso rāge ādīnavaṃ disvā rāgassa pahānaṃ paññāpema
an3.71:4.10: idaṃ dose ādīnavaṃ disvā dosassa pahānaṃ paññāpema
an3.71:4.11: idaṃ mohe ādīnavaṃ disvā mohassa pahānaṃ paññāpemāti.
an3.71:5.1: atthi panāvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etassa rāgassa dosassa mohassa pahānāyāti.
an3.71:5.2: atthāvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etassa rāgassa dosassa mohassa pahānāyāti.
an3.71:5.3: katamo panāvuso maggo katamā paṭipadā etassa rāgassa dosassa mohassa pahānāyāti.
an3.71:5.5: sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākammanto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi
an3.71:5.6: ayaṃ kho āvuso maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā etassa rāgassa dosassa mohassa pahānāyāti.
an3.71:5.7: bhaddako āvuso maggo bhaddikā paṭipadā etassa rāgassa dosassa mohassa pahānāya
